From: Lukas Meyer <lukas@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 20-30m runthrough for your recent uptick — suggest a slot

Hi Taylor,

I noticed NovusAI crossed a usage threshold yesterday on our hosted API — nice work getting that integration humming. I pulled a quick token/latency snapshot and I have a couple of low-friction suggestions (batching window, KV cache hints, and a short quantization check) that often cut per-token cost without changing outputs much.

Would you be open to a quick 20–30 minute runthrough so I can show the patterns I saw and a couple of config tweaks? I can cover:
- Where the spend is concentrated (prefix vs continued generation)
- One batching tweak that typically reduces tokens by ~12% for similar workloads
- When to consider a short QC test of a 4-bit profile

3 quick options (all PDT):
- Mon Aug 17, 11:00–11:30
- Mon Aug 17, 15:00–15:30
- Tue Aug 18, 09:00–09:30

If none of those fit, tell me a preferred window and I’ll swap it. I can bring Aditya (engineer) for the deep kernel/quant questions if you want — he’s cc’d.

Also attached is a short one-pager runbook I typically share with customers during these runthroughs: redwood-uptick-runbook.pdf (attachment).

Thanks — looking forward to helping you optimize.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
SDR, Redwood Inference
l: +1 (415) 555-0199
cal: https://cal.redwood.com/lukas/30min
